newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish November T-bill auction draws lower rates.
newsitem.headline: Danish November T-bill auction draws lower rates.

text.p: Denmark's central bank said on Thursday its monthly treasury bill auction resulted in minimum rates of 3.58 percent for the four-month and 3.62 percent for the seven-month series.
One month ago the four-month series, then with a maturity of five months, yielded 3.60 percent, with the seven-month series, at that time with eight-month maturity, yielding 3.66 percent.

The central bank said it sold 4.8 billion crowns worth of the four-month series and 4.5 billion crowns worth of the seven-month series, giving a total of 9.3 billion crowns for both series. -- Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33-969652
